description: Frozen N2.3 v1 CircuitPacketV1 wire format. These vectors are IMMUTABLE — any change to v1 encode/decode/AAD/nonce that produces different bytes is a protocol break and MUST require a version bump + ADR update + explicit approval. The conformance test in n215_traffic_forwarding.rs asserts against these exact hex bytes.

vectors.description: Encode a known v1 CircuitPacketV1 and verify the exact canonical CBOR bytes. Then decode back and verify equality.
vectors.notes: 5-entry CBOR map. Keys sorted by canonical encoded bytes: seq, ttl, payload, finalDst, circuitId. NO direction field, NO flowId field — these are v2-only.
